correctness.rationale: Exact point/block graph distance classes give the powered-distance block matrix. Singular decomposition from NN^T=(r-1)I+J exhausts the v+b-1 zero-sum modes. Block-kernel eigenvalue a((k-1)a-k) vanishes at a=k/(k-1) and is positive above it. At the endpoint, the other v-1 2x2 blocks are negative definite by det=(r-1)(a^2/(k-1)-(3^p-1)^2)>0, and the constant-population mode is negative by strict concavity; exact kernel dimension b-v. Schoenberg nesting and the centered Gram rank prove all claimed embeddability ranges and minimum dimensions. Four independent BFS/matrix checks corroborate the formulas.
